name: Left 4 Dead 2
description: Left 4 Dead 2 dedicated server (Steam app 222860). Steam only lets an anonymous login download the Linux server after the Windows one, so the install downloads both and takes a while. Allow about 20 GB of disk and at least 2 GB of memory.

variables.name: Map
variables.description: Map the server starts on. Campaign maps are named c<campaign>m<chapter>, for example c1m1_hotel (Dead Center) or c2m1_highway (Dark Carnival).

variables.name: Game Mode
variables.description: Game mode the server starts in: coop, realism, survival, versus, scavenge or a mutation such as mutation12.

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: Name shown in the server browser. A hostname line in left4dead2/cfg/server.cfg overrides it. Letters, numbers, spaces and _ . , : ! # ( ) + @ - only.

variables.name: RCON Password
variables.description: Password for remote console tools, which connect to the game port over TCP. Leave empty to keep RCON disabled.

variables.name: Update On Start
variables.description: Check Steam for a server update every time the server starts. If an update cannot be downloaded this way, reinstall the server to update it.

variables.name: Steam App ID
variables.description: Steam app id of the dedicated server. Used by the installer and by the update on start; do not change it.
